decisions.statement: The dump is read as text rather than as a grammar.
A name the dump describes is carried through unjudged.
A type the dump describes is judged before a declaration carries that type.
An opt-in list rather than the dump decides the tokens declared.
An enum a selected token names is selected too.
An object above a selected object is selected too.
Nothing here reads the clone or writes a file.

definition: the game's own API documentation dump read as TypeScript declarations
